subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should the pinned PR-limit announcement remain open as a live maintainer policy notice now that the 20-PR cap is documented and enforced elsewhere?
rationale: This is an administrative moderation policy with explicit maintainer reopen/pin activity, so a cleanup bot should not decide the visibility policy on its own.

options.title: Keep pinned notice open
options.body: Leave the issue open as the visible policy announcement while the hard 20-PR cap remains active.

options.title: Close after maintainer confirmation
options.body: Close the issue only if maintainers decide the contributor guide and automation labels are enough public surface for the policy.

recommendation.title: Keep pinned notice open
recommendation.body: Leave the issue open as the visible policy announcement while the hard 20-PR cap remains active.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman performed the later rename, repin, and reopen actions that made the issue an active 20-cap notice after the documentation work had landed.
